fichas.title: Spectator and VIP Areas
fichas.summary: Guidance on the placement and viewing conditions of stadium stands, including sight-line super-elevation, VIP accommodation, and roof coverage. Stand arrangements depend on spectator capacity; larger stands may surround the playing area. The page illustrates sight-line construction and stand sections.

dimensions.label: Approximate spectator capacity for stands around the entire playing area
dimensions.context: Stands may be placed around the entire playing area for more than approximately this number of places.

dimensions.context: Up to this number of rows, a linear gradient of 1:2 may be used for smaller stands.
dimensions.ocr_raw: up to 20 rows of standing places

fichas.title: Seated Areas
fichas.summary: Requirements for seating density, seat types, clear passage between rows, blocks and aisles, row capacities according to aisle access, and escape-route provision. Sitting and standing places must be separated.
